summary: John's 10th-great-grandfather, of Sagg (Sagaponack); gravestone at Bridgehampton.
bio:
Capt. Elnathan Topping of Sagg (1640–1705); recorded children 1664–1682; gravestone at Bridgehampton. In 1686 his father deeded Southampton lands to sons Elnathan and James. The Toppings lived at Sagg (Sagaponack) and Bridgehampton.

Savage records Elnathan's baptism at Milford on 2 Aug 1640, son of Thomas and Emma Topping, and his father's 1686 deed of the Southampton lands to Elnathan and James ([R4-S1]). Weygant (1897) gives his birth as 'Aug. 6, 1640' ([R4-S2]).
